effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] 1 of your Digimon with [Gaomon] or [Gaogamon] in its name gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[Your Turn] When an effect adds cards to your opponent's hand, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
